description: This file defines the QuizRepository class that interacts with the QuizService to fetch quizzes and submit quiz attempts. It acts as an intermediary between the UI and the data source, providing methods to list quizzes and submit answers.

classes.name: QuizRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve quiz data and submit quiz attempts via an injected QuizService.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a Future that resolves to a list of quizzes fetched from the QuizService.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits quiz answers for a specific quiz ID to the QuizService.
